prompt: How many countries were not listed as offering only paid access to YouTube Music at the time of its initial expansion in 2018?
answer: YouTube Music’s initial 2018 rollout covered **17 countries**—the original 5 markets plus 12 added in June—and access was not limited to paid subscriptions because an ad-supported tier was also available.
